<title id="_55ceab2b-b269-eff4-517c-331301f36712">9. Environment composition (locked 2026-07-27)</title>
<p id="_72ede84c-d415-aa83-5990-e4f5d298c02c">Env across the mount stack (runtime + toolkit layers + data layers + app) composes by RULE, never by accident:</p>

<ul id="_b33d6bff-3c76-3318-5cd0-f8dbd7ddcdc8"> <li> <p id="_383f2a1d-28f3-2dc6-8a08-fc527d3853d4"> <strong>Path-class vars</strong> (<tt>GEM_PATH</tt>, <tt>PATH</tt>-in-image, <tt>TEBAKO_LD_PATH</tt>): app payload first, then toolkit layers in  <tt>requires</tt> order, then the runtime — earlier wins. The runtime's own defaults come LAST (it is the fallback, not the override).</p>
